headline: Documentation covers a single in-progress task to write business and design documentation from the existing source code, and the code review could not confirm its progress either way.
what_is_there: The only item in this area is a documentation deliverable — producing business and design documents derived from the current system. Some module-level descriptions appear to exist in the project, but nothing that identifies itself as the requested business/design documents.
what_is_unclear: Whether the business and design documents have been started, drafted, or completed could not be determined, because this is a written deliverable rather than a software feature and code inspection is not the right way to observe it.
suggested_action: Ask the product owner or business analyst who owns this task to point to the current draft location and state of completion.
